title: xNNPCD identifies regulators of programmed cell death by integrating perturbation transcriptomes with cancer dependency profiles.
snippet: Programmed cell death (PCD) encompasses regulated processes whose dysregulation shapes cancer fitness, yet computational studies use known PCD genes for prognosis rather than discovering regulators. We developed xNNPCD, an interpretable neural-network framework that links CRISPR-Cas9 perturbation signatures from CMap to gene dependency profiles from DepMap....
